breakfast.name: Manakish (Lebanese Za'atar Flatbread)
breakfast.description: Traditional Lebanese flatbread topped with za'atar spice blend and olive oil, creating an aromatic, herbaceous breakfast staple served with bread, lemon, and cucumber yogurt
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in large bowl
Add warm milk and olive oil gradually while mixing
Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic
Cover and let rise in warm place for 1-1.5 hours until doubled
Divide dough into 8 portions and shape into balls
On oiled surface, flatten each ball into 1/4-inch thick round
Mix za'atar with olive oil to create paste-like topping
Spread 2 tbsp za'atar mixture on each dough round
Place on baking sheet and let rise 15-20 minutes
Bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes until edges are golden brown
Serve warm from oven on wooden boards with lemon wedges and cucumber yogurt
breakfast.notes: Za'atar is vibrant spice blend typically containing dried thyme, sumac, toasted sesame seeds, and oregano
breakfast.fun_fact: Manakish is an anchor of the Lebanese breakfast experience. The dough is similar to pizza dough but the topping is distinctly Middle Eastern
alternatives: Use olive paste instead of za'atar
